table.name: TLGNC_ASSIGNMENT
table.description: Contains the assignment information when an order is scheduled. This applies both to real trucks and planning trucks.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
column.description: The assignment number, used for external systems (SAP Shipment Document). Generated independently of assignment_id, based on sequence SLGNC_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER.

column.name: PLANNING_TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_TRUCK. The truck the delivery of the order is assigned to.

column.name: TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_TRUCK. The truck the delivery of the order is assigned to.

column.name: WAGON_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_WAGON. The wagon the delivery of the order is assigned to.

column.name: SIMPLE_VEHICLE_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SIMPLE_VEHICLE. The simple vehicle the delivery of the order is assigned to.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=canceled, 1=active.

column.name: ASSIGN_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_ASSIGN_STATUS_BS. Status of the assingment

column.name: ASSIGN_TR_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_ASSIGN_TR_STATUS_BS. Transmission status of the assingment

column.name: LOAD_ORDER_ID
column.description: Unique id for the weighing system. Built from separate sequence, as the assignment (load order) can be sent several times during its lifetime. NULL if the assignment is not currently known/confirmed in the external system (not transmitted or cancelled).

column.name: MATERIAL_QUANTITY
column.description: Quantity of the ordered material, in units defined by material_uom_cd. Used only for External Orders. For assignments belonging to normal orders, ordered/delivered quantities from tlgnc_order are used instead.

column.name: MATERIAL_UOM_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_UOM_BS. Unit of measure material_quantity is based on. Used only for External Orders. For assignments belonging to normal orders, ordered/delivered quantities from tlgnc_order are used instead.

column.name: MATERIAL_NAME
column.description: The name of the material. Used only for External Orders, which are not based on Crh products. For assignments belonging to normal orders, material information from tlgnc_order is used instead.

column.name: CARRIER_TRUCK_DRIVER_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the carrier for the driver. Text is entered during order dispatching / creation of external order. Initially copied from tlgnc_order.CARRIER_TRUCK_DRIVER_NOTE, if order exists. Copied back to tlgnc_order on delivery.

column.name: CARRIER_DISPATCHING_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the carrier for the dispatching (pool/carrier). Text is entered during order dispatching / creation of external order. Initially copied from tlgnc_order.CARRIER_DISPATCHING_NOTE, if order exists. Copied back to tlgnc_order on delivery.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_BS. The type of the assignment.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_DAT
column.description: Date of the assignment in timezone of the DB (CET/CEST). h:m:s are set to 0:0:0. This information is the same as the planned date on the assignment parts, however, it is always in CET/CEST, whereas the planned dates on assignment parts are in the timezone of the user. Used in search queries

column.name: MANUALLY_SCHEDULED
column.description: 1=manually scheduled on a real truck, 0=every other case (scheduled by LDS/not yet scheduled/etc).

column.name: LDS_CARRIER_CRM
column.description: Driver to put the 15 Alphanumberic code in SCHENCK and to be printed on DN.

column.name: LDS_SEAL_NUMBERS
column.description: Seal Numbers added by Operating during exiting phase, for truck and train. Maximum of four seals are possible per truck.

column.name: LDS_DRIVER_NAME
column.description: Name of the driver entered by the driver during registration.

column.name: LDS_DRIVER_CARD_NO
column.description: Driver Card Number entered by the driver during registration.

column.name: LDS_DRIVER_ID
column.description: Driver ID entered by the driver during registration.

column.name: LDS_ATTORNEY_NAME
column.description: Name of the attorney.

column.name: LDS_ATTORNEY_START
column.description: Power of attorney's first day of validity.

column.name: LDS_DISPATCHER_NAME
column.description: Gate Operator name during exit phase - person responsible (logged in user in WebDispoManager) following the windows logon

column.name: LDS_DISPATCHER_TEL
column.description: Gate Operator Phone number added by the Operator during exit phase (maintained in SCHENCK following the logged in user 'BEARBEITER').

column.name: LDS_DISPATCHER_ID
column.description: Gate Operator ID added by the Operator during exit phase (maintained in SCHENCK following the logged in user 'BEARBEITER').

column.name: MIN_START
column.description: Redundant information stored for query optimizing purposes. Contains the soonest assignment part's planned start or real start whichever is sooner. The start of the time range the assignment spans through. Used on scheduling to be able to determine if on a certain day the assignment has to show up or not. See also MAX_END.

column.name: MAX_END
column.description: Redundant information stored for query optimizing purposes. Contains the latest assignment part's planned start or real start whichever is later. The end of the time range the assignment spans through. Used on scheduling to be able to determine if on a certain day the assignment has to show up or not. See also MIN_START.
